title: MicroStrategy Announces BTC and ATM Activity

MicroStrategy Announces BTC and ATM Activity
Raised $2.03 billion; Purchased 27,200 BTC; Now Holds 279,420 BTC
TYSONS CORNER, Va., November 11, 2024 - MicroStrategy Incorporated today announced updates with respect to its bitcoin activity and holdings.
The Company today announced that, during the period between October 31, 2024 and November 10, 2024, the Company acquired approximately 27,200 bitcoins for approximately $2.03 billion in cash.
